meta.description: Revolut for Kids & Teens aged 6-15. Empower your kid to learn about money, in a parent-supervised space.

content.caption: Revolut for 6-15s | Parents and guardians
content.title: The account for kids and teens
content.description: A Revolut app and debit card for 6-15 year-olds. Empower your kid to learn about money, in a parent-supervised space. T&Cs apply.

content.title: Independence for them, peace of mind for you
content.description: Kids get the financial freedom of their own app and card, while you get visibility on your app. From spending limits to in-app card freezing, you’ve got total oversight.

items.title: Used by millions of families worldwide

image.alt: Used by millions of families worldwide

items.title: Freeze and unfreeze your kid’s card in-app

image.alt: Freeze and unfreeze your kid’s card in-app

items.title: Instant payment notifications for every transaction

image.alt: Instant payment notifications for every transaction

items.title: Controls on gambling, cigarettes, and alcohol

image.alt: Controls on gambling, cigarettes, and alcohol

content.title: Cards uniquely theirs
content.description: Let your kid’s personality shine through with card customisation. They can use their personalised card to make payments and withdraw from ATMs, even if they’re travelling abroad. Or they can go fully digital with virtual cards and add them to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
content.footnote: Customisation and delivery fees may apply. Minimum age applies.

items.title: Receiving money, from: you
items.description: You and your co-parent can set up recurring payments to automate their allowance, giving them a regular 'payday'. Kids and teens can also request money when they need it.
items.caption: Parent to kid

items.title: From: friends
items.description: Kids and teens can send and receive money from their Revolut friends and even add their personal touch with a note or GIF. Perfect for splitting the cost of movie tickets or a birthday gift.
items.caption: Kid to kid

items.title: From: anyone
items.description: Whether it’s from a part-time job, or from family members, your kid can receive money from trusted contacts via Payment Link, a custom QR code, or their Revtag — and voilà.
items.caption: Family & friends

content.title: Up to 4% AER (variable) interest on their savings
content.description: Open a savings account for free, and watch your kid start growing their money with up to 4% AER (variable), paid daily. And they can withdraw the money, anytime, without fees.
content.footnote: The Annual Equivalent Rate (AER) shows the interest you can earn over 1 year. AER is compounded, so you’ll earn interest on interest already earned. Interest is liable to applicable taxes. Rates depend on the parent/guardian’s plan. Paid Plan T&Cs apply.

content.title: Subscriptions worth £368 a year, included
content.description:
They'll get a bundle of 6 brand subscriptions, at no extra cost. Revolut — Kids & Teens T&Cs apply.

Only available to teens aged 13+.

items.title: Uber for teens
items.description: 40% off 3 rides for new customers, then 5% off every ride when you pay with Revolut.

items.title: Picsart Plus
items.description: Unlock all templates, stickers, AI tools, and premium editing features.

items.title: Chess.com Gold
items.description: Get unlimited lessons, puzzles, and deep game analysis.

items.title: Sleep Cycle Premium
items.description: Track sleep fully, detect snoring, and use smart sleep aids.

items.title: Headway
items.description: Read key ideas from 1,700+ books in minutes.

items.title: Nibble
items.description: Access interactive lessons across all subjects anytime.

items.title: Money, organised
items.description: Give your kid the tools to organise money with Pockets. These custom sub-accounts let them set aside money for specific purposes — whether that's a new pair of earbuds, or dinner with friends.
items.caption: Pockets
items.footnote: Pockets are not savings accounts and do not earn interest.

items.title: A 360° view of their money
items.description: Analytics help your kid see exactly where their money goes, instead of wondering where it went. They can track their spending trends in-app and get a full picture.
items.caption: Analytics

items.title: Goals that pay off
items.description: Teach kids and teens the power of becoming goal-oriented. Send their allowance easily, or even reward them as they complete challenges like chores and tasks.
items.caption: Challenges

content.title: Download the top-rated app for kids and teens accounts
How to open a Kids & Teens account

items.title: Get the app
items.description: Have your kid download the Kids & Teens app and create an account. If they’re 12 or under, you’ll need to create their account from your Revolut app.

items.title: Approve
items.description: If they’re 13 or over, we’ll send you a notification to let you know it’s time to approve their account from your Revolut app.

items.title: And go
items.description: Order their card, customise it together (fees may apply), and add it to their Apple or Google Wallet (if they’re old enough).

content.description:
Kids & Teens accounts are available for ages 6-15, and parent or guardian must be 18+ and have a Revolut account.

Teens aged 13+ can create an account with parent or guardian approval. Payments to and from other customers on Revolut — Kids & Teens are only available to teens aged 13+.

Some products and features are only available for kids above a certain age. See availability in-app or within our FAQs.
